recommendedBatches.acceptance: Ice Knife has promoted runtime evidence proving the burst always happens, includes the primary target in the save set, stays anchored to that target, and doubles only the primary attack's Piercing dice on critical hits.

recommendedBatches.title: Research Chromatic Orb Chained Attack Runtime
recommendedBatches.intent: Research and, only if tractable, promote Chromatic Orb chosen damage type and chained attack loop.
recommendedBatches.nextAction: Treat Chromatic Orb as a state-machine research task: chosen damage type, duplicate-face damage-roll gate, one hole after each qualifying hit, target uniqueness, and slot-level maximum leaps. Use git-history restore sources from the deleted Core/prototype lanes for inspiration, especially commits 3066c771 and 1f192c9c. Do not add chosen damage-type fields to all prepared spell invocation refs unless the exported helper API and every caller can produce them.
recommendedBatches.acceptance: Chromatic Orb is either split again into an implementable vertical slice with no support claim, or has promoted runtime evidence for the full chained-target loop; metadata-only continuation records are not support.

recommendedBatches.title: Promote Simple Scalar Buff Spell Runtime
recommendedBatches.intent: Promote False Life, Longstrider, and Shield of Faith as simple scalar HP, Speed, and AC effects.
recommendedBatches.nextAction: Cover temp HP, timed Speed bonus, concentration AC bonus, action/bonus-action cost, slot scaling, and source-owned cleanup.
recommendedBatches.acceptance: The scalar buff rows have promoted runtime evidence without mixing in roll modifiers, creature-type protection, or recurring turn-start effects.

recommendedBatches.title: Promote Roll Modifier Spell Runtime
recommendedBatches.intent: Promote Bane, Bless, and Guidance as D20 roll modifier spells.
recommendedBatches.nextAction: Model save-gated negative modifiers, unconditional positive modifiers, ability-check skill filtering where authored, concentration, and slot-scaled target counts.
recommendedBatches.acceptance: Roll modifier spell rows have promoted runtime evidence for the exact roll kinds they modify and do not duplicate roll facts beside the active effect.

recommendedBatches.title: Promote Protection and Charm Spell Runtime
recommendedBatches.intent: Promote Animal Friendship and Protection from Evil and Good as creature-type-scoped protection/charm effects.
recommendedBatches.nextAction: Keep Beast and creature-type filters executable, and make early-ending or scoped condition/attack effects explicit rather than metadata-only.
recommendedBatches.acceptance: Protection/charm rows have promoted runtime evidence for the selected executable subset and checker-visible blockers for any omitted SRD clauses.

recommendedBatches.title: Promote Heroism Turn-Start Runtime
recommendedBatches.intent: Promote Heroism as Frightened immunity plus turn-start Temporary Hit Points.
recommendedBatches.nextAction: Model concentration cleanup, target scaling, condition immunity, and attached target turn-start temp HP refresh.
recommendedBatches.acceptance: Heroism has promoted runtime evidence for both passive immunity and recurring turn-start temp HP without conflating those effects.

recommendedBatches.title: Promote Faerie Fire Area Reveal Runtime
recommendedBatches.intent: Promote Faerie Fire as area save-gated attack Advantage and visibility/invisibility-denial support where executable.
recommendedBatches.nextAction: Use caller-supplied cube facts; prove save-gated affected targets, concentration cleanup, and any supported Invisible/Dim Light subset.
recommendedBatches.acceptance: Faerie Fire has promoted runtime evidence for its attack-advantage effect and explicit blockers for object outline or light/invisibility clauses not yet executable.

recommendedBatches.title: Promote Resistance Damage Reduction Runtime
recommendedBatches.intent: Promote Resistance as chosen-damage-type reduction with once-per-turn semantics.
recommendedBatches.nextAction: Model the damage type choice, concentration duration, damage reduction fill, and per-turn usage cap.
recommendedBatches.acceptance: Resistance has promoted runtime evidence for one reduction per turn against the chosen damage type, or remains unsupported if the usage cap cannot be represented.

recommendedBatches.title: Promote Divine Favor Weapon Rider Runtime
recommendedBatches.intent: Promote Divine Favor as self-hosted extra Radiant damage on weapon hits.
recommendedBatches.nextAction: Attach the spell effect to the caster's weapon-hit damage path with timed duration and no target mark state.
recommendedBatches.acceptance: Divine Favor has promoted runtime evidence for extra weapon-hit damage without leaking into spell attacks or unarmed-only paths.

recommendedBatches.title: Promote Hunter's Mark Runtime
recommendedBatches.intent: Promote Hunter's Mark as marked-target damage plus zero-HP retargeting.
recommendedBatches.nextAction: Model mark identity, attack-roll hit damage against the mark, concentration, and Bonus Action retarget after the mark drops to 0 HP.
recommendedBatches.acceptance: Hunter's Mark has promoted runtime evidence for mark-scoped damage and retargeting without treating all caster attacks as eligible.

recommendedBatches.title: Promote Divine Smite After-Hit Runtime
recommendedBatches.intent: Promote Divine Smite as an immediate after-hit Bonus Action damage spell.
recommendedBatches.nextAction: Model the already-hit melee weapon/unarmed trigger, Bonus Action and slot spend, Radiant damage scaling, and Fiend/Undead bonus.
recommendedBatches.acceptance: Divine Smite has promoted runtime evidence for trigger eligibility and damage without replaying or duplicating the base attack.

recommendedBatches.title: Promote Ensnaring Strike Runtime
recommendedBatches.intent: Promote Ensnaring Strike as after-hit save-gated Restrained plus start-turn damage and escape.
recommendedBatches.nextAction: Model the weapon-hit trigger, save gate, concentration, Restrained ownership, start-turn Piercing damage, slot scaling, and escape action.
recommendedBatches.acceptance: Ensnaring Strike has promoted runtime evidence for both initial hit/save behavior and ongoing restrained damage lifecycle.

recommendedBatches.title: Promote Searing Smite Runtime
recommendedBatches.intent: Promote Searing Smite as after-hit Fire damage plus recurring start-turn damage/save-to-end.
recommendedBatches.nextAction: Model the immediate after-hit damage, timed duration, start-turn damage, Constitution save, success ending, and slot scaling.
recommendedBatches.acceptance: Searing Smite has promoted runtime evidence for immediate and recurring damage without collapsing the end-save into fixed expiration.

recommendedBatches.title: Promote True Strike Weapon Spell Runtime
recommendedBatches.intent: Promote True Strike as a spell-hosted weapon attack using spellcasting ability and damage type choice.
recommendedBatches.nextAction: Model material-component weapon eligibility, spellcasting ability override, Radiant-or-normal damage choice, and cantrip scaling.
recommendedBatches.acceptance: True Strike has promoted runtime evidence for the spell-hosted weapon attack without depending on generic weapon mastery behavior.

recommendedBatches.title: Promote Produce Flame Held Light Runtime

recommendedBatches.acceptance: Produce Flame held-light state has promoted runtime evidence without coupling it to the later hurled attack.

battleReadinessClosure.reason: The completed Metamagic subset is executable for the named promoted action-time Spell Invocation profiles and rejects unsupported procedures before Sorcery Point spending. Additional standalone damage, control, ongoing-effect, or other action-casting procedures must each add their own typed resource-threading and parity witness before they can opt into Quickened Spell; this is a procedure-owner product boundary, not an unresolved Level 10 Metamagic blocker.; Distant Spell now has a promoted object-light Touch-range slice, but additional target or origin procedures must each consume a typed cast-local range fact before range can be rewritten without trusting authored spell identity; Extended Spell now has a promoted Enlarge/Reduce duration slice, but additional duration-bearing procedures must each consume a typed cast-local duration fact before duration can be rewritten. Subtle Spell now has a promoted cast-local component projection slice, but future consumers such as stealth, audibility, visibility, Counterspell, hidden-caster, free-hand, Silence, and procedure-specific component requirements remain outside this profile. Unsupported cast-property options remain rejected before Sorcery Point spending rather than charging inert Metamagic.; The promoted Empowered Spell slice is owned by the pending single spellAttackDamage rolledDice continuation for Ray of Frost. Repeated spell attacks need invocation-local one-use accounting, allocation spells need allocation-aware dice ownership, and save/ongoing/object damage owners must each consume the typed reroll facts before they can admit Empowered without charging inert Metamagic or storing a parallel reroll opportunity state.; The promoted Seeking Spell slice is owned by the pending single spellAttackDamage Attack Roll continuation. Repeated spell attack sequences need a procedure-local accounting fact that allows at most one Seeking reroll for the whole spell casting across multiple attack rolls before Scorching Ray or similar procedures can consume the same post-miss boundary.
